ns2:course.label: Systems Engrg & Economics
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the formulation and solution of optimization problems in civil engineering from a quantitative economics-based perspective, integrated with the computational tool Python. Topics include engineering economics, classical optimization, linear and integer programming, network optimization problems, critical path methods, and decision theory. Credit is not given for both CEE 201 and IE 310. Prerequisite: MATH 231; CS 101 or CS 124; credit or concurrent registration in MATH 257 or MATH 415.
